summary: We've developed a game for kids to learn about Lunar Rocks! they are going to prepare for flight and then go to moon to collect rocks.
details:
Mission AstroMeow is an interactive 2D space mission simulation designed for children aged 7–13, transforming abstract space science and engineering concepts into a hands-on learning experience. Instead of passively memorizing textbook facts, young learners step into the paws of a feline astronaut to plan, execute, and survive a realistic lunar expedition built in the Godot 4 game engine.

The gameplay unfolds across two educational phases. First, during pre-flight preparation inside the spacecraft, players manage time and resources by installing Polyethylene radiation bricks, Multi-Layer Insulation (MLI) shielding, and mission rations. Second, after an animated spaceflight to the Moon, children explore a top-down lunar terrain to identify and collect target minerals such as Basalt and Anorthosite using scientific clues.

By combining approachable character design, immediate cause-and-effect feedback, and authentic NASA space weather data, AstroMeow fosters critical thinking, scientific literacy, and lasting curiosity in STEM fields.
